relations.subject: Sayagyi U Ba Khin
relations.evidence: In 1952, the International Meditation Centre (I.M.C.) was opened in Rangoon, two miles north of the Shwedagon Pagoda.

relations.subject: Sayagyi U Ba Khin
relations.evidence: Ba Khin progressed well during this first ten-day course, and continued his practise during frequent visits to his teacher's center and meetings with Thet Gyi whenever he came to Rangoon.

relations.subject: Saya Thet Gyi
relations.evidence: Thet Gyi was a wealthy farmer and disciple of the renowned master Ledi Sayadaw, who taught him anapana-sati

relations.subject: Sayagyi U Ba Khin
relations.evidence: Webu Sayadaw was impressed with Ba Khin's proficiency in meditation, and urged him to teach. The monk was the first person to exhort Ba Khin to start teaching.

relations.subject: Mya Thwin
relations.evidence: These centres are guided by his disciple Mya Thwin, known to her followers as Mother Sayamagyi.

relations.subject: S. N. Goenka
relations.evidence: Another student of Ba Khin is S. N. Goenka.
